typography.rationale: Plus Jakarta Sans is a refined, low-noise sans with confident geometry—its restraint signals seniority and control. Source Sans 3 offers humanist warmth and exceptional readability at small sizes, ideal for dense SaaS proof content. The pairing is stylistically distinct (geometric vs humanist), creating a frictionless hierarchy that lets outcomes—not decoration—carry the message.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Outreach leads with one crisp observation about their funnel and a single recommended action—short, useful, and respectful of time. On-site copy is spare, scannable, and organized by decisions buyers need to make. We never brag, never stack adjectives, and never bury the lead. Filter: if a word doesn’t add clarity or evidence, it’s cut.
brand_voice.example_headline: Less noise. More qualified demos for your PLG motion.

why_these_colors: A nearly-black slate primary with surgical teal accents communicates quiet control and efficiency—the restraint itself signals confidence. Cold neutrals and high contrast enable rapid scanning of benchmarks and proof. This palette helps FirstSignal feel organized, senior, and focused on outcomes over aesthetics.
